title: Germany: two languages, two locations.
description: A Germany demonstration website showing how one Foundation website can support multiple languages and locations.

sections.lede: This is the Germany demonstration website in the Foundation reference installation. It has its own pages and address, supports German and English, and uses Berlin and Frankfurt to demonstrate location-specific information.

items.title: English
items.body: You are reading the English version. Use **Language** to switch to German while staying on the corresponding page.

items.title: Deutsch
items.body: The German version belongs to the same website and follows the same routes, with content written for German readers.

sections.heading: Berlin and Frankfurt are demonstration data
sections.body: Berlin and Frankfurt are included only to demonstrate locations. They are not real Provelopment offices. Replace them with the locations that belong to your organisation.

items.title: Its own website and content
items.body: The Germany website has its own address and its own content. It is separate from the Global demonstration website while sharing the same Foundation installation.

sections.heading: Locations belong inside the website
sections.body: **Berlin** and **Frankfurt** are locations within this website. Choosing a location keeps you on the same website and in the same language while showing the information that applies to that location.

sections.heading: This configuration is only an example
sections.body: The languages and locations shown here are demonstration choices. A Foundation website can use the languages and locations that make sense for the organisation it represents.
